data.name: Send & Defend
data.detailed_description:
Send & Defend is a competitive multiplayer tower defense game where players attack and defend at the same time. Build a maze and towers to stop incoming creeps while sending your own waves into another player’s battlefield. Every creep you send increases your income, allowing you to strengthen your defenses or launch even more dangerous attacks. Watch enemy defenses, adapt your strategy and protect your portal until the end.

SEND TO GROW STRONGER

Sending creeps does more than pressure your rivals. Every unit you send increases your income for the rest of the match.

Use your resources to build stronger defenses, send a more dangerous wave. Spend too much on towers and your rivals may outgrow you. Focus only on attacking and your own portal could be left exposed.

Every player faces the same decisions and each new wave raises the stakes.

CARVE YOUR OWN MAZE

At the beginning of each match, carve the route incoming creeps must follow through your battlefield. 

Create long paths, build deadly choke points and decide where your towers can deal the most damage. Your maze forms the foundation of your defense so plan carefully before the first wave arrives.

BUILD TOWERS AND SEND CREEPS

Place towers along the path to stop incoming waves before they reach your portal.

At the same time, assemble your own waves and send them into another player’s battlefield. Choose which creeps to deploy and test how well their defenses hold up.

Every wave is another chance to expose a weakness.

WATCH YOUR RIVALS

Switch to a rival battlefield at any time.

Study their maze, inspect their towers and see how they react to your attacks. Adapt your next attack to the defenses taking shape.

You are never fighting blindly.

CREATE YOUR OWN TOWERS

Play matches to earn tower tiles, then combine them in the Tower Builder to create custom towers. Experiment with different combinations, save your creations and build a collection of towers suited to your strategy.

BUILD YOUR TOWER DECK

Choose which custom towers you want to bring into battle and add them to your tower deck.

Prepare a flexible selection for different situations or build your entire deck around a particular strategy. As your collection grows, so do the ways you can defend your portal.

OUTLAST THE COMPETITION

Creeps that survive a maze pass through the portal. Each creep that reaches a rival’s portal takes one life from them and adds it to your own total. Break through often enough to eliminate your rivals. Protect your own portal, grow your economy and stay in the fight until only one player remains.

Make sure your portal is the last one left.

KEY FEATURES

⚔️ Competitive Multiplayer: Attack rival battlefields while defending your own portal.

🐍 Carve Your Maze: Play a Snake-style opening phase to shape the path incoming creeps must follow.

👹 Send Creeps: Choose your creeps and exploit weaknesses in rival defenses.

💰 Grow Your Income: Every creep you send increases your income for the rest of the match.

❤️ Steal Their Lives: Creeps that reach a rival portal take one of their lives and add it to your own.

👁️ Watch Your Rivals: Switch between enemy battlefields and adapt to their towers and mazes.

🏗️ Build Custom Towers: Combine foundations, tower bodies and weapons in the Tower Builder.

🔥 Elemental Synergies: Chain elements across your towers to trigger powerful combination effects.

🃏 Build Your Tower Deck: Arrange your custom towers into a personal upgrade tree for the next match.

data.short_description: Send & Defend is a competitive multiplayer tower defense game where players attack and defend at the same time. Carve a maze, build towers and send waves of creeps to grow your income and overwhelm your rivals. Watch enemy defenses, adapt your waves and outlast the competition.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible card with 4 GB+ VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Win 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible card with 8 GB+ VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

content_descriptors.notes:
Send & Defend contains mild, stylized fantasy violence typical of the tower defense genre. Towers attack waves of enemy creatures using projectiles, elemental effects, and melee attacks. Defeated creeps disappear or play a brief non-graphic death animation. All characters and enemies use a stylized, low-poly art style no gore, dismemberment, or realistic injury depiction.

Gameplay is purely competitive strategy between the players.
